args.subject: Update Needed: Billing Contact Address for Your Account C-7013
args.body:
Dear Customer,

We understand that invoices are currently being sent to an outdated billing address (billing@adatum.org). To correct this, could you please provide the new billing email address you would like us to use?

Once we receive the updated information, we will promptly update our records, process your $175 late‑fee refund, and confirm the changes.

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,
Support Team
